A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Human''' was one of several leaders in the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion]] in [[3643 BBY]]. He was killed some time during the rebellion by an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Cipher Nine|Agent]].<ref name="The Slave's Secret" />
